enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Sleep on back. Turn to side. Sleep on stomach. Turn to other side. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and taking a hot shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up in bed. Sit up. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off pajamas. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Wash face. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Take out jam. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Take out knife. Wait for toast. Toast pops up. Take toast out. Place on plate. Spread butter. Spread jam. Pour coffee into mug. Sit at table. Pick up toast. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Finish breakfast. Stand up. Clear plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work uniform, packing work bag and checking phone for the day's patient schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out uniform. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Open bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Close bag. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open schedule app. Scroll through patient list. Check times. Lock phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a physiotherapist, assessing and treating patients in the rehabilitation ward
enriched_activities.desc: Enter rehabilitation ward. Wash hands. Greet patient. Review patient chart. Assist patient to sit up. Help patient stand. Walk with patient. Demonstrate exercise. Guide patient through exercise. Monitor patient. Write notes. Move to next patient. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at the hospital cafeteria
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay at cashier. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Stand up. Return tray. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing physiotherapy sessions, writing patient notes and handing over to colleagues
enriched_activities.desc: Enter ward. Greet patient. Treat patient. Write notes. Meet colleague. Handover patient details. Discuss treatment plans. Continue sessions. Write more notes. Handover to next shift.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Sit. Check phone. Get off. Walk home. Enter home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off cooker. Plate food. Sit at table. Eat. Drink. Finish. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the kitchen and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start. Wipe counter. Wipe stove. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on air conditioner. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Browse. Put phone down. Adjust air conditioner. Watch more TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking an evening shower and doing a short stretching routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Take off clothes. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Wrap towel. Do stretching: raise arms. Bend forward. Touch toes. Stretch legs. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer to review rehabilitation literature and plan tomorrow's patient exercises
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on light. Turn on desk lamp. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Search for rehabilitation literature. Open article. Read. Take notes. Open planning document. Type exercises. Save. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, browsing phone and setting tomorrow's alarm
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open social media. Scroll. Open alarm app. Set alarm for 6:30. Put phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.
Lie down. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Sleep on back. Turn to side. Sleep on stomach. Turn to other side. Continue sleeping.
